description: Get the signed receipts for our real test payments to one x402 endpoint: the exact payment terms we paid and the response we got (as SHA-256 hashes), amount quoted and paid, payout wallet, HTTP status, result and time, signed with our published Ed25519 key. Use it when a user or agent wants evidence behind a grade instead of the grade alone; check_endpoint gives the grade itself. The tester wallet and transaction appear only after that test wallet is retired (until then a hash commits to them). Read-only and free; receipts exist for tests since Nov 7, 2026.
